unverified.reason: No check available to this map can prove it. The {run} token is a property of a map a test-builder writes under the new runner, and this map must run under the current one, which does not expand {run}; the only artefact that could show it is a map produced by a test-builder dispatched inside a run, and no such artefact exists before the run. Provable once flight check expands {run} and a run has dispatched the test-builder against a sample launch.

No deterministic check can produce it. The scribe returning assembled false requires dispatching the scribe against a launch with an input removed, which needs a model; the testbench has no probe harness and the conventions forbid a check that is not deterministic. Provable once a probe harness exists that can dispatch one subagent against a fixture, with a declared trials count and threshold.
